Liam: Quick follow-up RFC q: what's the minimal control-plane <-> runtime handshake across hosted/dedicated/private? Trying to avoid leaking auth/token types into the runtime.
Anya: Keep it tiny: identity assertion (opaque), capability manifest, telemetry sink hint. Secrets live in control plane for hosted; private gets opaque refs. :thinking:
Sophia: Agreed. For private we must support customer KMS/HSMs. Runtime should only accept opaque key refs (e.g. kms://...) and request unwrap via control-plane bridge when needed. No raw keys passed.
Mike: Also add a lightweight probe/discovery endpoint so control plane can check features/limits. Suggested fields: protocol_version, features[], max_seq_len, q_profiles[].
Liam: Quick proto sketch (rough):
```json
{
  "protocol_version": "1",
  "identity": "opaque-jwt-or-mtls-ref",
  "capabilities": ["streaming","kv_cache:v2","quant:int8","max_tokens:4096"],
  "telemetry_sink": "otel:http://collector:4318"
}
```
Anya: Tradeoff note 12: richer capability manifests let control plane do smarter routing/fallbacks but increase coupling and testing surface. Proposal: v1 = minimal, v1-ext = opt-in extended fields.
Sophia: Edge case: dedicated pools that enforce tenant affinity. Manifest should expose something like "tenant_affinity": "shared|tenant-bound" so router respects placement/eviction constraints.
Mike: infra-bot: add conformance: probe response < 2s and capability keys stable across restarts.
infra-bot: conformance-check queued for adapters in staging (run id: 202).
Liam: Action items: I will draft RFC patch with proto + ext pattern; Mike adds tests to adapter-harness; Anya/Sophia enumerate private KMS flows and failure modes.
Mike: Will create test matrix: hosted/dedicated/private x auth-mode x telemetry config.
Anya: Also define failure semantics when manifest fields are missing: fallback to conservative defaults + emit audit event.
Sophia: And add exponential backoff for control-plane -> runtime probe to avoid noisy retries during maintenance windows.
Liam: I'll open the RFC PR today with the sketch. Ping if objections. :thumbsup:
Mike: LGTM from infra; will review PR tomorrow.
Anya: I'll draft a short ops-runbook snippet for mismatched manifests (rollback + mitigation).
Liam: Filing this as RFC followup: handshake-probe-and-manifest.
